decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API extends the firm's established messaging platform at low marginal cost on its own infrastructure, and with industry growth and organisational slack there is no shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search or justify withdrawal.

The email-to-SMS gateway was launched only in 2024 and fits the firm's core of integrated secure communication channels, so its uncertain early results can be carried on available slack without prompting a search for other uses of the resources.
The SMS-to-email gateway complements Products A and B within the same messaging suite, so with no evident performance gap and slack to absorb its still-unclear results, management keeps it.
